notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause Ill-Tempered Loner // Howlpack Avenger to take damage.
description:
Cause Ill-Tempered Loner // Howlpack Avenger to take damage by any method.
Ill-Tempered Loner // Howlpack Avenger triggers, dealing damage to an opponent.
Guilty Conscience triggers, dealing damage to Ill-Tempered Loner // Howlpack Avenger.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.name: Guilty Conscience
uses.cardState: attached to Ill-Tempered Loner // Howlpack Avenger
